closes: both implementation-gap rows of plans/msca_dn_pe09_runbook.md section 11 that blocked stage A step 1: the original's document configuration, and a fidelity register renderer for a submitted document. V14's second criterion is what they unblock.
authority: Agent-authored under CLAUDE.md. Advisory, out-of-band QA for a private run this repository does not perform. Closes no gate and confers no authority. The original's own values are the operator's, and acceptance is the operator's.
decision: The five fields the official original still needed are declared in a file the operator authors inside the private network, checked against the dry import's own measurement, and applied to the selected document configuration at run time. The submitted document gets a register renderer of its own, and the importer chooses between the two by the document's own is_submitted_document flag.
why: V07 made the document configuration selectable and V08 built the measurement a page map is declared from, but nothing carried a private declaration into an import. The V08 procedure told the operator to declare the page map, the page count, the body point size, the work-package layout and the graph root on OFFICIAL_ORIGINAL in this repository, which would have put the submitted document's structure here. And the importer renders a register per revision, so render_register's refusal of a submitted document blocked the original's import outright rather than only withholding a header.

reported_as_a_finding.how_the_coverage_is_held: The test reads the finding names out of the reader's own source and asserts every one is produced by a case. A finding added to the reader and not to the test fails there rather than passing unnoticed; the same rule holds the four unchecked answers.
the_ones_that_carry_the_ticket: page_count_disagrees_with_the_measurement, body_point_size_not_measured and body_point_size_is_not_the_largest_share: the declaration stands against the measured distribution rather than beside it
marker_not_measured_anywhere and marker_not_on_its_declared_page: every numbered marker is matched against the blocks the dry import reported as candidate headings, within the declared tolerance
page_in_no_sub_section_and_not_declared: a page the map does not reach is a finding unless the input declares it with a basis, so a cover page is an answer and silence is not
measurement_is_not_the_one_declared and measurement_measured_another_file: the configuration is bound to one inventory by its bytes, and to the authenticated hash by the inventory's own
declared_pdf_is_not_the_authenticated_file: the import cannot read a file the operator did not authenticate

side_effect.what: One V07-class defect, found because the original became importable. The import manifest's claims block carried the sentence 'the sanitisation removed every citation', rendered by a generic renderer from no configuration. Rendered into the original's manifest it would have asserted a sanitisation of the submitted text.
side_effect.now: claim_ledger_note is a required document configuration field, and import_ticket is a declared one. The copy declares the sentence it was already rendering, so both hash-bound manifests keep their bytes; the original declares that no claim of its own is resolved to a source until X01.
side_effect.basis: the copy's --check still exits 0 and a test holds the two sentences apart

the_declaration_contract.why: The submitted original's declarations cannot live under this repository's Tier 3, and the question its operator answers per sub-section is not the copy's.

known_gaps: No page map for the real original exists. The route is here and the declaration is the operator's, produced in the private network.

register_document holds a completed configuration for the life of the process, because its revisions are declared at run time. A configuration id DOCUMENTS does not declare cannot be registered, and a revision another document owns cannot be taken.
The register names the ESR by path and not by hash: the ESR is a public artifact of this repository, and a hash the private root cannot produce is not restated there.

The evaluator scorecard an unlabelled sub-section takes its title from is copied into the private root from this repository. It is public, so nothing private moves, but the import then reads that copy.
The grounding axis is unchanged. A claim the original carries is extracted, counted and never resolved to a source until ticket X01.
not_evidence_of: that the original has been imported, here or anywhere this repository can see
that the extraction of the original preserves anything: the reconciliation settles that page by page, and the register refuses to be written until it is complete
that a result over the original would be comparable with the ESR's
that the private environment permits any content to be sent or to leave it
that V17 or V18 is accepted. Acceptance is the operator's.
